guard: `readRunRevocation` reads the revocation marker key, answers undefined only when there is no marker, and throws on a marker it cannot read; `revokeRunAdmission` refuses a marker with an empty by or reason before it creates anything
why: THE CORE HALF OF implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/ps-revocation.json. That fixture proves
the same three edits through `cotal run ps` and `cotal run revoke`, which is the entry point an
operator reaches. Its suite imports `@cotal-ai/core` by name, so `mutation-coverage` cannot see
that it reaches `packages/core/src` and refuses to grade those three. This suite imports
`../src`, so the contract is graded where it is written, and it no longer depends on the
runtime table staying where it is.
Each mutation is the positive control for the other two: all three edit run-admission.ts.

mutations.name: the reader looks at the admission key instead of the revocation marker
mutations.find:
const marker = await readLeader(jsm, space, revocationKey(endpoint, runId));
  return marker === undefined ? undefined : revocationSnapshot(marker.value, runId);
mutations.replace:
const marker = await readLeader(jsm, space, admissionKey(endpoint, runId));
  return marker === undefined ? undefined : revocationSnapshot(marker.value, runId);
mutations.cell: readRunRevocation returns the marker a revoke wrote
mutations.expectRed: readRunRevocation returns the marker a revoke wrote
mutations.note: The revoked run in this block has no admission record, so the admission key reads as absent and the marker a revoke wrote is never seen.

mutations.name: the marker reader answers no marker when it could not look
mutations.cell: readRunRevocation throws on a marker version it does not know, never answering no marker
mutations.expectRed: readRunRevocation throws on a marker version it does not know, never answering no marker
mutations.note: No marker and could not look are different answers. Swallowed, a caller renders a revoked run as live the moment its marker cannot be read.

mutations.name: the writer accepts a revocation with an empty by and reason
mutations.cell: revokeRunAdmission refuses a marker with an empty by and reason and creates nothing
mutations.expectRed: revokeRunAdmission refuses a marker with an empty by and reason and creates nothing
mutations.note: The marker is permanent, so a revocation that names nobody and no reason is refused before the create.
